name: Post-audit ligand correction, 2026-09-22
status: Prospective specification for this corrected pass; original results already known, not independent preregistration
historical_outputs: Read only; write all corrected outputs in this directory

C12_C14.senders: Deposited category Epithelial; explicit source allowlist per donor
C12_C14.donor_floor: At least 50 epithelial cells and 50 Fibroblast/Myofibroblast cells combined
C12_C14.method: Installed LIANA CellChat, expr_prop=0.1, n_perms=None, normalize_total(1e4), log1p
C12_C14.aggregation: Maximum score across allowed source-target subtype pairs per donor and molecular pair; ordinal descending score ranks with deterministic pair/source/target tie breaks; median across donors; present in at least ceil(N/2) eligible donors
C12_C14.provenance: Preserve every scored source-target pair and the winning source/target in separate per-resource tables
C12_C14.guard: Historical C14 COL/LAM/FN1 or ITG/SDC/CD44 rule, descriptive only; passing does not establish communication or absence of abundance bias
C12_C14.EGFR: Report historical exact EGFR pairs separately from complexes containing EGFR; no missing complex parsed as biological absence
C12_C14.limits: No permutation significance, spatial evidence, functional interaction or disease contrast; same pooled IPF/control design as original

C37.annotation: Deposited major types, tumour lung only, donor Sample, >=50 cells in each compartment
C37.baseline: AREG >0 from original E1 cached deposited log2TPM values
C37.depth: Stream raw UMI matrix once for totals, detected genes and AREG counts in those same tumour epithelial/myeloid cells
C37.primary_depth_sensitivity: 1000-UMI exact expected AREG detection under molecule sampling without replacement; retain cells with >=1000 UMIs; retain donor groups with >=50 retained cells
C37.test: Two-sided paired Wilcoxon on donor means, no cell-level p-values; budgets are sensitivity analyses, not independently confirmatory tests
C37.limits: Depth matching changes sampled cells; UMI depth can include biological RNA-content differences; annotation and residual composition remain unverified
